description: This file implements GStreamer metadata handling for Rialto's EME protection, including functions for initializing, freeing, registering, and adding protection metadata to buffers.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_init
methods.description: Initializes the protection metadata, setting info to NULL.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_free
methods.description: Frees the info structure if it exists.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Registers and returns the GType for the protection metadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns the GstMetaInfo for the protection metadata, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer with the provided GstStructure info.
